description: King St. Transit Pilot - Detailed Bluetooth Travel Time is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The King Street Transit Pilot launched on Sunday, November 12, 2017 between Bathurst Street and Jarvis Street. The Pilot aims to improve transit reliability, speed, and capacity by prioritizing streetcars over private vehicles. This dataset includes travel times measured along the King St. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are king st pilot, traffic, transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in GZ, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-03-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is open-government-licence-toronto. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
